provision.quote: impugned order dated 24.08.2024 passed by the Respondent No. 1 under Section 73 of the Delhi Goods and Service Tax Act, 2017

service_mode.quote: it is undisputed that the Impugned Order was merely uploaded on the Web Portal and was never otherwise served upon the Petitioner.

events.quote: impugned order dated 24.08.2024 passed by the Respondent No. 1

defects_argued.quote: Learned Counsel representing the parties are ad idem that Notification No.56/2023-Central Tax, extending the period of limitation for opening the case, is presently the subject matter of challenge before the Hon’ble Supreme Court.
In the present case, the Impugned Order was passed after the Petitioner had submitted a Reply to the Show Cause Notice.

outcome.quote: In view of the aforesaid position, the present Writ Petition is disposed of in terms of the principles laid down in Paragraph No.60 of Luxmi Traders(supra).
